==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am in a car on a highway. I look out the window. I see a rocket launching upwards into space.

The rocket starts to crash back down. I feel like I have to do something to save the rocket. I summon a cloud of purple fire to try and catch the rocket.

Using the cloud of fire like a trampoline, I launch the rocket back into space. This earns me a spot at an academy for superhero studies. Despite my earlier achievement, I struggle in my classes and need the help of a friendly tutor to get by.
